name: TecraSpace
fix_description: In burnFrom, the allowance check is reversed: _allowances[msg.sender][from] should be _allowances[from][msg.sender]. Similarly, _approve(msg.sender, from, ...) should be _approve(from, msg.sender, ...). The current code checks/deducts the wrong direction of allowance, allowing anyone to burn any holders tokens.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, direct exploit built around an obvious missing-access-control issue: the attacker can call burnFrom on the pool's TCR balance, then sync the pair and dump their own TCR for inflated USDT. The PoC is under 100 lines, uses only a few straightforward external calls, and requires minimal DeFi knowledge beyond basic Uniswap pair reserve syncing.
